lines_of_business: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan of the Mid-Atlantic States; 'For Medicare members, please consult the Medicare Coverage Database' (NCD/LCD first)
sections_in_order: III. Clinical Guidelines (A. Clinical Indications for Referral; B. Documentation)
IV. Limitation and Contraindication (A. Limitations; B. Contraindications)
criteria_location: Section III.A (11 numbered criteria), III.B documentation, IV.A/B limitations and 18 contraindications, V replacement; pp.1-3.
procedures_covered: Hypoglossal nerve stimulator implantation for OSA

logic.top_level: all (11 numbered criteria joined by 'and;'), with an 11th item that opens a case-by-case door for under-18
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate section IV.B with 18 contraindications ('any of the following'), several of which duplicate positive criteria (BMI >= 35; central + mixed > one-quarter of AHI), plus a pointer from criterion 8 to 'section IV-B'. IV.A says not medically necessary for other indications / if not all criteria met / non-FDA device.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: V: 'Replacement of HNS is medically necessary when there is documentation that the stimulator and/or generator is malfunctioning, cannot be repaired, or no longer under warranty.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: malfunctioning, cannot be repaired, or no longer under warranty
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three conditions joined by 'or'; unlike BCBSFL (not functioning AND out of warranty) any one suffices, and 'malfunctioning, cannot be repaired' may be one condition or two.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Patients under age 18 will be considered on a case-by-case basis e.g., Down's syndrome
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Criterion 1 requires age 18 or older and criterion 11 admits under-18; no numbers. Sits in an ALL list but contradicts item 1.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Shared Decision-Making (SDM) between the patient, sleep physician, and qualified otolaryngologist ... who determines that the patient demonstrates CPAP failure ... or CPAP intolerance
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Criterion fuses a process (SDM) with a clinical finding; who must document?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: BMI is less than 35 kg/m2 ... BMI 35 kg/m2 or greater
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Consistent here, but criterion and contraindication say the same thing twice.

requirement_kinds.quote: Patient is 18 years of age or older
Body Mass Index (BMI) is less than 35 kg/m2
A sleep study ... PSG or a home sleep study in the last 12 months. ... apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) of 15-65 events per hour within 24 months of initial consultation
central and mixed apneas less than 25% of the total AHI

CPAP failure (defined as AHI greater than 15 despite CPAP usage) or CPAP intolerance (... usage less than 4 hours a night for at least 70% of the nights in 1 month, or the CPAP has been returned) despite CPAP interface and/or setting optimizations
Confirmed absence of complete concentric collapse at the soft palate level by a drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) procedure
Absence of anatomical findings that would compromise performance of device (such as tonsil size 3 or 4 ...)
Absence of any HNS contraindicated condition such as severe obstructive or restrictive lung disease and significant cardiovascular disease including CHF ...
The HNS device ... has Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval
HNS must be furnished ... in a setting (either inpatient or outpatient setting) appropriate to the patient's medical needs
Shared Decision-Making (SDM) between the patient, sleep physician, and qualified otolaryngologist
Medical history and physical examination notes; Conservative treatment of OSA has failed; CPAP trial result; Sleep Study result in the last 12 months ...; DISE result
Patient who is or who plans to become pregnant; ... New York Heart Association class III or IV heart failure; Recent myocardial infarction or severe cardiac arrhythmias (within the past 6 months)

extraction_hazards: Running header repeated mid-list splits item 8 across a page ('Please refer to section IV-B ... HNS contraindicated condition' continues after header)
Section III.A criteria separated by 'and;' tails
Contraindication list stray comma line; inconsistent 'within 24 months' vs 'in the last 12 months'
Criterion 5 packs two definitions in parentheses
Contraindication (BMI >= 35, central > 25%) duplicates positive criteria - risk of double counting
References include MCG citation with no content
interesting_structures: Positive criteria + separate contraindication list with cross-reference
Shared decision making as a required process
Two timing windows on the sleep study (12 months vs 24 months)

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: A single numbered all-of with a NOT list; numeric leaves are crisp. The case-by-case under-18 item, open-ended contraindications, and the SDM process criterion are the only strain.
